camel_example: aliyun ens CreateCluster --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterType Kubernetes --Profile Default
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-cluster --cluster-type Kubernetes --biz-profile Default --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCluster

parameters.help_en:
Kubernetes or ManagedKubernetes. The former indicates an ECK cluster, and the latter indicates a serverless VC.
Must be used together with the profile parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Kubernetes or ManagedKubernetes，前者为eck集群，后者为serverles vc
必须与profile参数一起使用
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en:
Default or Serverless. The former indicates an ECK cluster, and the latter indicates a serverless VC.
Must be used together with the cluster_type parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Default or Serverless，前者为eck集群，后者为serverless vc
必须与cluster_type参数一起使用
parameters.name: profile

parameters.help_en: The ENS Region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster version, which is consistent with the Kubernetes community baseline version. Select the latest version. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 集群版本，与 Kubernetes 社区基线版本保持一致。建议选择最新版本，若不指定，默认使用最新版本
parameters.name: kubernetes_version

parameters.help_en: The VPC used by the cluster
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the vSwitches for cluster nodes. The ENS Region of the vswitch_ids must be the same as the ens_region_id value
parameters.help_zh: 集群节点所在虚拟交换机id。vswitch_ids所处 ENS Region 必须与ens_region_id一致
parameters.name: vswitch_ids

parameters.help_en: Each pod vSwitch corresponds to a worker node vSwitch. The zone of the pod vSwitch must be the same as that of the worker node vSwitch. If you do not specify this parameter, vswitch_ids is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 每个 Pod 虚拟交换机分别对应一个 Worker 节点的虚拟交换机，Pod 虚拟交换机和 Worker 节点的虚拟交换机的可用区需保持一致。如果不填，默认使用vswitch_ids
parameters.name: pod_vswitch_ids

parameters.help_en: The pod network CIDR block. The CIDR block must be a valid private CIDR block, which includes the following CIDR blocks and their subnets: 10.0.0.0/8, 172.16-31.0.0/12-16, and 192.168.0.0/16. The CIDR block cannot overlap with the CIDR blocks used by the VPC or existing Kubernetes clusters in the VPC. You cannot modify the CIDR block after the cluster is created
parameters.help_zh: Pod 网络地址段，必须是有效的私有网段，即以下网段及其子网：10.0.0.0/8、172.16-31.0.0/12-16、192.168.0.0/16。不能与 VPC 及 VPC 内已有 Kubernetes 集群使用的网段重复，创建成功后不能修改
parameters.name: container_cidr

parameters.help_en: The service network CIDR block. Valid ranges: 10.0.0.0/16-24, 172.16-31.0.0/16-24, and 192.168.0.0/16-24. The CIDR block cannot overlap with the VPC CIDR block 10.1.0.0/21 or the CIDR blocks used by existing Kubernetes clusters in the VPC. You cannot modify the CIDR block after the cluster is created
parameters.help_zh: Service 网络地址段，可选范围：10.0.0.0/16-24，172.16-31.0.0/16-24，192.168.0.0/16-24 不能与 VPC 网段 10.1.0.0/21 及 VPC 内已有 Kubernetes 集群使用的网段重复，创建成功后不能修改
parameters.name: service_cidr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public network access. The API Server is exposed through an EIP to enable public access to the cluster.
● true: Enable public network access.
● false: Disable public network access. If you select this option, you cannot access the cluster API Server from the Internet.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公网访问。通过 EIP 暴露 API Server，实现集群公网访问。
● true：开启公网访问。
● false：不开启公网访问。选择不开放时，则无法通过外网访问集群 API Server。
默认值：false
parameters.name: public_access

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance used for API Server access. If you specify this parameter, automatic creation of a CLB instance for the API Server is skipped
parameters.help_zh: 指定用于 APIServer 访问的 CLB 实例 ID。指定该参数时，将不再自动创建 APIServer CLB
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The control plane virtual machine image ID
fields.help_zh: 控制面虚拟机镜像 ID
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en: The logon password for the cluster control plane machines
fields.help_zh: 集群控制面机器登录密码
fields.name: login_password

fields.help_en: The control plane node runtime name
fields.help_zh: 控制面节点运行时名称
fields.name: runtime

fields.help_en: The number of control plane nodes. Valid values: 3 and 5
fields.help_zh: 控制面节点数量，可选值3或5
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The node system cloud disk type. Valid values: "local_ssd", "cloud_ssd", "cloud_efficiency", "local_hdd"
fields.help_zh: 节点系统盘类型，可选类型："local_ssd", "cloud_ssd", "cloud_efficiency", "local_hdd"
fields.name: system_disk_category

fields.help_en: The node system cloud disk size
fields.name: system_disk_size
